description: Security configuration for Aura Enterprise Marketplace with SAP BTP XSUAA

scopes.name: $XSAPPNAME.ProductManager
scopes.description: Product catalog and promotional campaign management access

scopes.name: $XSAPPNAME.OrderManager
scopes.description: Sales order lifecycle and logistics fulfillment access

scopes.name: $XSAPPNAME.InventoryManager
scopes.description: Warehouse inventory management and stock reconciliation access

role-collections.name: MarketplaceCustomer
role-collections.description: Access to customer storefront, cart, wishlist, and orders

role-collections.name: MarketplaceSeller
role-collections.description: Access to seller portal, merchant offers, and product stock

role-collections.name: MarketplaceProductManager
role-collections.description: Access to manage products, categories, variants, and promotions

role-collections.name: MarketplaceOrderManager
role-collections.description: Access to manage orders, shipments, deliveries, and returns

role-collections.name: MarketplaceInventoryManager
role-collections.description: Access to manage inventory, stock thresholds, and warehouses

role-collections.name: MarketplaceAdministrator
role-collections.description: Full access to all marketplace administration services
